triggers: Any spoken instruction, question, article, copula, yes/no word, or sentence form appears.
Any mismatch lacks an explicit visible wrong label and unique replacement.
Any story page is missing, out of order, visually contradictory, or paired with the wrong caption.
Any story-sequence worked example or scored answer is not the true adjacent page.
Any asset hash, exact pixel review, or required control is unavailable.

finish.eligibility: All four controlled gates pass under gate_execution, mixed reaches 26 of 32, every story page is emitted, all story-backed checks pass, all post-story transfer checks are recorded, and closing_recap reaches 6 of 8.

mixed_execution.stop_rule: Run all 32 frozen mixed items once, then evaluate 26-of-32 before any TRAIN_LONGER release.

present_again.release_rule: Replay only the local model bound to a gate after three failed cold items in that gate.
present_again.return_rule: Replay the mapped presentation once, then continue with the next not-yet-scored frozen base item; modeled output receives no credit.

replay_lesson.release_rule: At most once after a complete non-alarm execution fails aggregate mastery.
replay_lesson.stop_rule: After one full replay, finish if mastery passes; otherwise defer and revisit.

train_longer.ordering_rule: Use only the frozen order after the base mixed block; never release TRAIN_MORE reserves here.
train_longer.stop_rule: Stop after eight additional mixed items or on completion fraction 0.8.

story_arc.meaningful_development: In one connected, hand-free visual sequence, the same eight objects are shown one at a time leaving the loose group and appearing in their distinct display positions. Each transition preserves exactly one cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, drinking glass, and napkin; the object currently shown is locally paired with its bare label, while movement and position remain nonverbal staging rather than scored language or spatial knowledge.
story_arc.resolution_or_stopping_state: The loose-object area is empty and exactly one cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, drinking glass, and napkin are simultaneously visible in the eight completed display positions. No text, characters, hands, food, duplicates, disappearance, or extra objects.
